comment: Single source of truth for the cron dialect this project emits. Both the Python decoder (eval/) and the JS decoder (web/src/) load this file, and grammar/conformance.json pins their agreement.

notes.dow: 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Cron also accepts 7 for Sunday; this dialect never emits it so output stays canonical.
notes.monthNames: Three-letter names (JAN, MON) are valid cron but are never emitted, for the same canonical-output reason.
notes.macros: @daily-style macros are out of scope; everything is 5-field.
notes.dom: 1-31 is allowed by the grammar. A month-restricted expression naming February plus day 30 is unreachable in the training distribution and is caught by the post-generation cron-parser check rather than by this automaton.
